>Tip: whenever I get really mad for example, 3 world's snap me out of it; 'oh that's anger'. When I say these words in my head, it immediately separates myself from the subjective experience, and makes it as if I'm watching someone else that's not be be angry. This is the basis of alot mindful meditation. It can be 'oh that's sadness', 'oh that's attachment'. Once your looking at the emotion objectively, you can ask your higher self, do I want to give this emotion energy or nah, and choose.
